## Primary analysis: pooled overall survival

Our primary analysis asks whether double-high tumors (ligand and receptor both above the cohort median, with medians taken over all patients of the cohort) have different overall survival from all other tumors. We fit a Cox proportional hazards model adjusted for age (continuous), stage (TCGA AJCC I to IV, METABRIC stage 0 to 4) and PAM50 subtype (LumA, LumB, Her2, Basal, Normal-like, and claudin-low in METABRIC), in all patients of each cohort. Stage X, missing stage and unclassified PAM50 calls are treated as missing, so the primary model uses complete cases. TCGA survival comes from the TCGA Pan-Cancer Clinical Data Resource (TCGA-CDR), matched to expression on the 12-character patient barcode (1,081 of 1,082 patients), and METABRIC survival from cBioPortal. The log hazard ratios of the two cohorts are pooled with an inverse-variance fixed-effect meta-analysis, with a random-effects (REML) estimate and Cochran's Q and I² as checks. We correct the five axes with Benjamini-Hochberg and call q below 0.05 significant. We report the number of patients and events of every model, and check proportional hazards with `cox.zph`. If the exposure term of a model violated proportional hazards, we would also report the hazard ratio with follow-up censored at 10 years. A model that fails to converge, or whose hazard ratio or interval falls outside 10^-3^ to 10^3^, is reported as "not estimable".

```{r}
#| label: clinical-load-processed
#| eval: true
meta_pub <- qs_read("objects/phase2/clinical_metabric_processed.qs2")
tcga_pub <- qs_read("objects/phase2/clinical_tcga_processed.qs2")

# Variable preparation shared with the Cox models below
meta_pub$os_time <- as.numeric(meta_pub$OS_MONTHS)
meta_pub$os_stat <- ifelse(grepl("1|DECEASED|Dead", meta_pub$OS_STATUS, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)
meta_pub$Age_Clean <- as.numeric(meta_pub$AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS)
meta_pub$Stage_Clean <- ifelse(is.na(meta_pub$TUMOR_STAGE) | meta_pub$TUMOR_STAGE == "", NA_character_, paste("Stage", meta_pub$TUMOR_STAGE))
tcga_pub$os_time <- as.numeric(tcga_pub$OS_MONTHS)
tcga_pub$os_stat <- ifelse(grepl("1|DECEASED|Dead", tcga_pub$OS_STATUS, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)
tcga_pub$Age_Clean <- as.numeric(tcga_pub$AGE)
tcga_pub$Stage_Clean <- case_when(
  grepl("STAGE I[AB]?$", tcga_pub$AJCC_PATHOLOGIC_TUMOR_STAGE) ~ "Stage I",
  grepl("STAGE II[AB]?$", tcga_pub$AJCC_PATHOLOGIC_TUMOR_STAGE) ~ "Stage II",
  grepl("STAGE III[ABC]?$", tcga_pub$AJCC_PATHOLOGIC_TUMOR_STAGE) ~ "Stage III",
  grepl("STAGE IV", tcga_pub$AJCC_PATHOLOGIC_TUMOR_STAGE) ~ "Stage IV",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
```

```{r}
# Exposures use medians over all patients of the cohort
add_axis_exposures <- function(df) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(candidate_registry))) {
    ax <- candidate_registry$axis_id[i]
    lig <- df[[candidate_registry$ligand[i]]]
    rec <- df[[candidate_registry$receptor[i]]]
    hl <- lig > median(lig, na.rm = TRUE)
    hr <- rec > median(rec, na.rm = TRUE)
    df[[paste0("dh_", ax)]] <- as.integer(hl & hr)
    df[[paste0("hl_", ax)]] <- as.integer(hl)
    df[[paste0("hr_", ax)]] <- as.integer(hr)
    df[[paste0("zl_", ax)]] <- as.numeric(scale(lig))
    df[[paste0("zr_", ax)]] <- as.numeric(scale(rec))
    df[[paste0("zs_", ax)]] <- as.numeric(scale((lig + rec) / 2))
  }
  df %>% mutate(
    z_immune = as.numeric(scale(immune_score)),
    z_stromal = as.numeric(scale(stromal_score)),
    z_purity = as.numeric(scale(TumorPurity))
  )
}

tcga_rev <- add_axis_exposures(tcga_rev)
meta_rev <- add_axis_exposures(meta_rev)
```

In the 1,081 TCGA patients with a CDR record, the legacy cBioPortal `OS` and `PFS` columns are identical to the CDR overall survival and progression-free interval, so the TCGA "progression-free survival" in this analysis is the recommended progression-free interval.

```{r}
#| label: rev-survival-helpers
#| eval: true
# One Cox fit, returning the exposure term with N, events, estimability and optional PH tests
cox_term <- function(df, time, status, rhs, term, zph = FALSE) {
  fit <- coxph(as.formula(sprintf("Surv(%s, %s) ~ %s", time, status, rhs)), data = df)
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[term])
  se <- unname(sqrt(diag(vcov(fit)))[term])
  hr <- exp(b)
  lo <- exp(b - 1.96 * se)
  hi <- exp(b + 1.96 * se)
  estimable <- is.finite(se) && fit$iter < coxph.control()$iter.max &&
    lo > 1e-3 && hi < 1e3
  out <- data.frame(n = fit$n, events = fit$nevent, b = b, se = se, hr = hr, lo = lo, hi = hi,
                    p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(b / se)), estimable = estimable)
  if (zph) {
    ph <- cox.zph(fit)$table
    out$zph_p_term <- ph[term, "p"]
    out$zph_p_global <- ph["GLOBAL", "p"]
  }
  out
}

# Inverse-variance fixed effect with a REML random-effects sensitivity; non-estimable cohorts are dropped
pool_iv <- function(b, se) {
  keep <- is.finite(b) & is.finite(se)
  if (sum(keep) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(k = 0, b_fe = NA_real_, se_fe = NA_real_, hr_fe = NA_real_, lo_fe = NA_real_, hi_fe = NA_real_,
                      p_fe = NA_real_, hr_re = NA_real_, lo_re = NA_real_, hi_re = NA_real_, p_re = NA_real_,
                      het_q_p = NA_real_, i2 = NA_real_))
  }
  fe <- rma(yi = b[keep], sei = se[keep], method = "FE")
  re <- if (sum(keep) > 1) rma(yi = b[keep], sei = se[keep], method = "REML") else fe
  data.frame(
    k = sum(keep), b_fe = fe$b[1], se_fe = fe$se,
    hr_fe = exp(fe$b[1]), lo_fe = exp(fe$ci.lb), hi_fe = exp(fe$ci.ub), p_fe = fe$pval,
    hr_re = exp(re$b[1]), lo_re = exp(re$ci.lb), hi_re = exp(re$ci.ub), p_re = re$pval,
    het_q_p = if (sum(keep) > 1) fe$QEp else NA_real_,
    i2 = if (sum(keep) > 1) re$I2 else NA_real_
  )
}

fmt_hr <- function(hr, lo, hi, estimable = !is.na(hr)) {
  ifelse(estimable, sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", hr, lo, hi), "not estimable")
}

primary_covars <- "age + stage + pam50"
cohort_data <- list(TCGA = tcga_rev, METABRIC = meta_rev)
```

```{r}
#| label: clinical-text-helpers
#| eval: true
# Look up a value in a results table by column and filters, and format pooled hazard ratios for the text
pick <- function(df, col, ...) {
  f <- list(...)
  keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(df))
  for (n in names(f)) keep <- keep & df[[n]] == f[[n]]
  df[[col]][keep]
}
hr_text <- function(df, ...) fmt_hr(pick(df, "hr_fe", ...), pick(df, "lo_fe", ...), pick(df, "hi_fe", ...))
```

```{r}
#| label: rev-primary-survival
#| eval: true
primary_cohort <- list()
for (ax in candidate_registry$axis_id) {
  for (coh in names(cohort_data)) {
    term <- paste0("dh_", ax)
    primary_cohort[[length(primary_cohort) + 1]] <- cox_term(
      cohort_data[[coh]], "os_time", "os_stat", paste(term, "+", primary_covars), term, zph = TRUE
    ) %>% mutate(axis_id = ax, cohort = coh)
  }
}
primary_cohort <- bind_rows(primary_cohort)

primary_pooled <- primary_cohort %>%
  group_by(axis_id) %>%
  group_modify(~ pool_iv(.x$b[.x$estimable], .x$se[.x$estimable])) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(q_bh = p.adjust(p_fe, method = "BH"))

# PH follow-up: 10-year administrative censoring wherever the exposure term violates PH

for (j in seq_len(nrow(ph_flagged))) {

    mutate(axis_id = ph_flagged$axis_id[j], cohort = ph_flagged$cohort[j])
}

write_csv(primary_cohort, "results/revision/survival_primary_by_cohort.csv")

write_csv(ph_followup, "results/revision/survival_primary_ph_10y.csv")
```

In the primary analysis of `r format(sum(primary_cohort$n[primary_cohort$axis_id == "fn1_itga5_itgb1"]), big.mark = ",")` patients (`r sum(primary_cohort$events[primary_cohort$axis_id == "fn1_itga5_itgb1"])` deaths), FN1-ITGA5/ITGB1 double-high status is associated with worse overall survival: pooled hazard ratio `r hr_text(primary_pooled, axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1")`, p = `r sg(pick(primary_pooled, "p_fe", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1"), 2)`, BH q = `r sg(pick(primary_pooled, "q_bh", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1"), 2)`, in the same direction in both cohorts and with no heterogeneity (I² = `r round(pick(primary_pooled, "i2", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1"))`%). It is the only one of the five axes that passes the primary test. CCL5-ACKR1 gives `r hr_text(primary_pooled, axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1")` (q = `r sg(pick(primary_pooled, "q_bh", axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1"), 2)`), and the other three axes are null (@fig-survival-primary).

The exposure terms satisfy proportional hazards in every primary model (all p above 0.2), so the 10-year censoring follow-up was not needed. The global test fails in METABRIC, which comes from the covariates: the effects of subtype and age are known to vary over follow-up in this cohort. As a check, we stratify the baseline hazard by PAM50 instead of adjusting for it.

```{r}
#| label: rev-primary-ph-stratified
#| eval: true
zph_covars <- lapply(names(cohort_data), function(coh) {
  fit <- coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(os_time, os_stat) ~ dh_fn1_itga5_itgb1 +", primary_covars)), data = cohort_data[[coh]])
  data.frame(cohort = coh, term = rownames(cox.zph(fit)$table), p = cox.zph(fit)$table[, "p"])
})
knitr::kable(bind_rows(zph_covars), digits = 4, caption = "cox.zph by term, FN1-ITGA5/ITGB1 primary model")

strat_rows <- list()
for (ax in candidate_registry$axis_id) {
  for (coh in names(cohort_data)) {
    term <- paste0("dh_", ax)
    strat_rows[[length(strat_rows) + 1]] <- cox_term(
      cohort_data[[coh]] %>% filter(!is.na(pam50)), "os_time", "os_stat", paste(term, "+ age + stage + strata(pam50)"), term, zph = TRUE
    ) %>% mutate(axis_id = ax, cohort = coh)
  }
}
strat_cohort <- bind_rows(strat_rows)
strat_pooled <- strat_cohort %>%
  group_by(axis_id) %>%
  group_modify(~ pool_iv(.x$b, .x$se)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(q_bh = p.adjust(p_fe, method = "BH"))
write_csv(strat_pooled, "results/revision/survival_primary_pam50_stratified.csv")
knitr::kable(
  strat_pooled %>% transmute(Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], `Pooled HR (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(hr_fe, lo_fe, hi_fe), p = signif(p_fe, 3), q = signif(q_bh, 3)),
  caption = "Post-hoc sensitivity: Cox model stratified by PAM50 subtype (age and stage adjusted)"

```

This model gives `r hr_text(strat_pooled, axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1")` for FN1-ITGA5/ITGB1 (q = `r sg(pick(strat_pooled, "q_bh", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1"), 2)`). We report it as an additional analysis, because the proportional-hazards check prompted it.

Missing stage and PAM50 calls cost patients: multiple imputation (`mice`, 20 imputations, seed 42) of stage and PAM50 recovers 118 TCGA patients, mostly with unclassified PAM50, and 517 METABRIC patients, mostly with missing stage. The imputation model uses age, the five double-high indicators, the event indicator and the Nelson-Aalen cumulative hazard, plus auxiliary staging variables (METABRIC: tumor size, positive lymph nodes, grade, ER and HER2 status; TCGA: pathological T, N and M), with Rubin's rules within each cohort followed by pooling.

```{r}
#| label: rev-mi-sensitivity
#| eval: true
mi_path <- "objects/revision/mi_imputations.qs2"
dh_cols <- paste0("dh_", candidate_registry$axis_id)

if (file.exists(mi_path)) {
  mi_list <- qs_read(mi_path)
} else {
  # Nelson-Aalen cumulative hazard and the event indicator stand in for the outcome (White & Royston 2009)
  mi_input <- list(
    TCGA = tcga_rev %>%
      filter(!is.na(os_time), !is.na(os_stat)) %>%
      select(os_time, os_stat, age, stage, pam50, t_cat, n_cat, m_cat, all_of(dh_cols)),
    METABRIC = meta_rev %>%
      filter(!is.na(os_time), !is.na(os_stat)) %>%
      select(os_time, os_stat, age, stage, pam50, tumour_size, nodes_pos, grade, er, her2, all_of(dh_cols))
  )
  mi_list <- lapply(mi_input, function(df) {
    df$na_haz <- nelsonaalen(df, os_time, os_stat)
    pred <- make.predictorMatrix(df)
    pred[, "os_time"] <- 0
    mice(df, m = 20, maxit = 10, seed = 42, predictorMatrix = pred, printFlag = FALSE)
  })
  qs_save(mi_list, mi_path)
}

mi_rows <- list()
for (ax in candidate_registry$axis_id) {
  for (coh in names(mi_list)) {
    f <- as.formula(sprintf("Surv(os_time, os_stat) ~ dh_%s + %s", ax, primary_covars))
    fits <- lapply(seq_len(mi_list[[coh]]$m), function(j) coxph(f, data = complete(mi_list[[coh]], j)))
    pooled_fit <- summary(pool(as.mira(fits)))
    row <- pooled_fit[pooled_fit$term == paste0("dh_", ax), ]
    mi_rows[[length(mi_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(axis_id = ax, cohort = coh, n = nrow(mi_list[[coh]]$data),
                                                 b = row$estimate, se = row$std.error)
  }
}
mi_cohort <- bind_rows(mi_rows) %>% mutate(hr = exp(b), lo = exp(b - 1.96 * se), hi = exp(b + 1.96 * se), p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(b / se)))
mi_pooled <- mi_cohort %>%
  group_by(axis_id) %>%
  group_modify(~ pool_iv(.x$b, .x$se)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(q_bh = p.adjust(p_fe, method = "BH"))
write_csv(mi_cohort, "results/revision/survival_mi_by_cohort.csv")
write_csv(mi_pooled, "results/revision/survival_mi_pooled.csv")

knitr::kable(
  mi_cohort %>% transmute(Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], cohort, N = n, `HR (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(hr, lo, hi), p = signif(p, 3)) %>%
    left_join(mi_pooled %>% transmute(Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], `Pooled HR (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(hr_fe, lo_fe, hi_fe),
                                      `Pooled p` = signif(p_fe, 3), q = signif(q_bh, 3)), by = "Axis"),
  caption = "Primary model after multiple imputation of stage and PAM50 (m = 20, Rubin's rules)"
)
```

FN1-ITGA5/ITGB1 stays significant after imputation (pooled `r hr_text(mi_pooled, axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1")`, q = `r sg(pick(mi_pooled, "q_bh", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1"), 2)`), and the other axes stay null.

## Secondary endpoints and subtypes

We then ask whether the primary result extends to other endpoints and to subtypes. These analyses are secondary and exploratory, and each family is corrected on its own with Benjamini-Hochberg.

- **Alternative endpoints (20 tests).** TCGA progression-free and disease-free interval from the TCGA-CDR, and METABRIC disease-specific survival (death from disease is the event, death from other causes is censored) and relapse-free survival, each in the all-patient model.
- **Pooled recurrence endpoint (5 tests).** TCGA progression-free interval pooled with METABRIC relapse-free survival.
- **PAM50 subtype strata (15 tests).** Pooled overall survival in the PAM50 luminal (LumA and LumB), HER2-enriched and basal-like strata, with medians recomputed within the stratum and adjustment for age and stage. In both cohorts subtype is defined by PAM50 only, which reduces the METABRIC luminal stratum to 1,175 patients (888 complete cases). Adding a second subtype classifier would give 1,410 patients.
- **Continuous axis score (5 tests).** The score of an axis, the mean of the log2 ligand and receptor, z-scored within cohort, per standard deviation, with the primary covariates.

```{r}
#| label: rev-secondary-survival
#| eval: true
endpoint_specs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~cohort, ~endpoint, ~time, ~status,
  "TCGA", "PFI", "pfi_time", "pfi_stat",
  "TCGA", "DFI", "dfi_time", "dfi_stat",
  "METABRIC", "DSS", "dss_time", "dss_stat",
  "METABRIC", "RFS", "rfs_time", "rfs_stat"
)

# S1: alternative endpoints, per cohort (20 tests)
s1_rows <- list()
for (k in seq_len(nrow(endpoint_specs))) {
  for (ax in candidate_registry$axis_id) {
    term <- paste0("dh_", ax)
    s1_rows[[length(s1_rows) + 1]] <- cox_term(
      cohort_data[[endpoint_specs$cohort[k]]], endpoint_specs$time[k], endpoint_specs$status[k],
      paste(term, "+", primary_covars), term, zph = TRUE
    ) %>% mutate(axis_id = ax, cohort = endpoint_specs$cohort[k], endpoint = endpoint_specs$endpoint[k])
  }
}
s1 <- bind_rows(s1_rows) %>% mutate(family = "S1 alternative endpoints", q_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))

# S2: pooled recurrence endpoint (TCGA PFI + METABRIC RFS)
s2 <- s1 %>%
  filter(endpoint %in% c("PFI", "RFS")) %>%
  group_by(axis_id) %>%
  group_modify(~ pool_iv(.x$b, .x$se)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(family = "S2 pooled PFI/RFS", q_bh = p.adjust(p_fe, method = "BH"))

# S3: PAM50 subtype strata, medians recomputed within stratum, adjusted for age and stage (15 tests)
strata_def <- list(Luminal = c("LumA", "LumB"), HER2 = "Her2", Basal = "Basal")
s3_rows <- list()
for (st in names(strata_def)) {
  for (coh in names(cohort_data)) {
    df_st <- cohort_data[[coh]] %>% filter(pam50 %in% strata_def[[st]])
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(candidate_registry))) {
      ax <- candidate_registry$axis_id[i]
      lig <- df_st[[candidate_registry$ligand[i]]]
      rec <- df_st[[candidate_registry$receptor[i]]]
      df_st$dh_stratum <- as.integer(lig > median(lig, na.rm = TRUE) & rec > median(rec, na.rm = TRUE))
      s3_rows[[length(s3_rows) + 1]] <- cox_term(df_st, "os_time", "os_stat", "dh_stratum + age + stage", "dh_stratum") %>%
        mutate(axis_id = ax, cohort = coh, stratum = st)
    }
  }
}
s3_cohort <- bind_rows(s3_rows)
s3 <- s3_cohort %>%
  group_by(axis_id, stratum) %>%
  group_modify(~ pool_iv(.x$b[.x$estimable], .x$se[.x$estimable])) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(family = "S3 subtype strata", q_bh = p.adjust(p_fe, method = "BH"))

# S4: continuous axis score per SD (5 tests)
s4_rows <- list()
for (ax in candidate_registry$axis_id) {
  for (coh in names(cohort_data)) {
    term <- paste0("zs_", ax)
    s4_rows[[length(s4_rows) + 1]] <- cox_term(cohort_data[[coh]], "os_time", "os_stat", paste(term, "+", primary_covars), term, zph = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(axis_id = ax, cohort = coh)
  }
}
s4_cohort <- bind_rows(s4_rows)
s4 <- s4_cohort %>%
  group_by(axis_id) %>%
  group_modify(~ pool_iv(.x$b, .x$se)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(family = "S4 continuous axis score", q_bh = p.adjust(p_fe, method = "BH"))

write_csv(s1, "results/revision/survival_S1_alternative_endpoints.csv")
write_csv(s2, "results/revision/survival_S2_pooled_recurrence.csv")
write_csv(s3_cohort, "results/revision/survival_S3_subtype_by_cohort.csv")
write_csv(s3, "results/revision/survival_S3_subtype_pooled.csv")
write_csv(s4_cohort, "results/revision/survival_S4_continuous_by_cohort.csv")
write_csv(s4, "results/revision/survival_S4_continuous_pooled.csv")

knitr::kable(
  s1 %>% transmute(Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], cohort, endpoint, `HR (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(hr, lo, hi, estimable),
                   p = signif(p, 3), q = signif(q_bh, 3), N = n, events, zph_p = signif(zph_p_term, 3)),
  caption = "S1: alternative endpoints, all patients, primary covariates (BH across 20 tests)"
)
knitr::kable(
  s2 %>% transmute(Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], `Pooled HR (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(hr_fe, lo_fe, hi_fe), p = signif(p_fe, 3), q = signif(q_bh, 3), I2 = round(i2, 1)),
  caption = "S2: pooled recurrence endpoint (TCGA PFI + METABRIC RFS)"
)
knitr::kable(
  s3_cohort %>% transmute(Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], stratum, cohort, `HR (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(hr, lo, hi, estimable), p = signif(p, 3), N = n, events),
  caption = "S3: subtype strata by cohort (PAM50 only)"
)
knitr::kable(
  s3 %>% transmute(Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], stratum, k, `Pooled HR (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(hr_fe, lo_fe, hi_fe), p = signif(p_fe, 3), q = signif(q_bh, 3), I2 = round(i2, 1)),
  caption = "S3: pooled subtype strata (BH across 15 tests; non-estimable cohort models excluded from pooling)"
)
knitr::kable(
  s4 %>% transmute(Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], `Pooled HR per SD (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(hr_fe, lo_fe, hi_fe), p = signif(p_fe, 3), q = signif(q_bh, 3), I2 = round(i2, 1)),
  caption = "S4: continuous axis score per SD, pooled OS"
)
```

For FN1-ITGA5/ITGB1, the disease-specific survival association in METABRIC reaches a hazard ratio of `r fmt_hr(pick(s1, "hr", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", cohort = "METABRIC", endpoint = "DSS"), pick(s1, "lo", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", cohort = "METABRIC", endpoint = "DSS"), pick(s1, "hi", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", cohort = "METABRIC", endpoint = "DSS"))` (q = `r sg(pick(s1, "q_bh", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", cohort = "METABRIC", endpoint = "DSS"), 2)`), and the pooled recurrence endpoint gives `r hr_text(s2, axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1")` (q = `r sg(pick(s2, "q_bh", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1"), 2)`). In the luminal stratum the pooled estimate is `r hr_text(s3, axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", stratum = "Luminal")` (nominal p = `r sg(pick(s3, "p_fe", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", stratum = "Luminal"), 2)`, q = `r sg(pick(s3, "q_bh", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", stratum = "Luminal"), 2)`). Nothing else among the alternative endpoints stands out. For CCL5-ACKR1, the dichotomized association is concentrated in luminal tumors (pooled `r hr_text(s3, axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1", stratum = "Luminal")`, nominal p = `r sg(pick(s3, "p_fe", axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1", stratum = "Luminal"), 2)`, q = `r sg(pick(s3, "q_bh", axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1", stratum = "Luminal"), 2)` within the subtype family), and it does not survive correction.

In TCGA basal-like tumors every model is flagged as not estimable. The non-convergence comes from the stage covariate, because there are no deaths among stage I basal-like patients, while the exposure estimate itself is stable. It is kept in `survival_S3_subtype_by_cohort.csv` and not pooled. The TCGA HER2 model for CXCL12-CXCR4 is not estimable because the double-high group has no deaths.

The continuous axis score is more informative than the dichotomy. Per standard deviation, the FN1-ITGA5/ITGB1 score has a pooled hazard ratio of `r hr_text(s4, axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1")` (q = `r sg(pick(s4, "q_bh", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1"), 2)`, I² = `r round(pick(s4, "i2", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1"))`%), and the CCL5-ACKR1 score is protective, with `r hr_text(s4, axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1")` (q = `r sg(pick(s4, "q_bh", axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1"), 2)`). The CCL5-ACKR1 association is nominally significant in each cohort on its own. APP-CD74 shows a pooled hazard ratio of `r sprintf("%.2f", pick(s4, "hr_fe", axis_id = "app_cd74"))` with opposite directions in the two cohorts (I² = `r round(pick(s4, "i2", axis_id = "app_cd74"))`%), so it is not interpretable.

## Tumor composition and benchmarks

Bulk expression mixes cell types, so an association of an axis with survival could be an association of immune or stromal content with survival. We probed this in several ways, all with the primary covariates and pooled over the two cohorts: adding the ESTIMATE immune and stromal scores and the purity to the model; testing the ligand alone and the receptor alone; and a model of the continuous ligand, receptor and their product. In the interaction model, the CCL5 by ACKR1 term directly tests whether ACKR1 counteracts the protective effect of CCL5, as proposed by Yang and Du (2026), which would appear as an interaction hazard ratio above 1. We also fit the continuous score together with the ESTIMATE covariates, as an additional analysis.

```{r}
#| label: rev-composition-models
#| eval: true
comp_specs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~model, ~rhs_template, ~terms_template,
  "Double-high + ESTIMATE (immune, stromal, purity)", "dh_%1$s + %2$s + z_immune + z_stromal + z_purity", "dh_%1$s",
  "Ligand high only", "hl_%1$s + %2$s", "hl_%1$s",
  "Receptor high only", "hr_%1$s + %2$s", "hr_%1$s",
  "Continuous ligand x receptor", "zl_%1$s * zr_%1$s + %2$s", "zl_%1$s|zr_%1$s|zl_%1$s:zr_%1$s",
  "Continuous axis score + ESTIMATE (post hoc)", "zs_%1$s + %2$s + z_immune + z_stromal + z_purity", "zs_%1$s"
)

comp_rows <- list()
for (k in seq_len(nrow(comp_specs))) {
  for (ax in candidate_registry$axis_id) {
    rhs <- sprintf(comp_specs$rhs_template[k], ax, primary_covars)
    for (term in strsplit(sprintf(comp_specs$terms_template[k], ax), "\\|")[[1]]) {
      for (coh in names(cohort_data)) {
        comp_rows[[length(comp_rows) + 1]] <- cox_term(cohort_data[[coh]], "os_time", "os_stat", rhs, term) %>%
          mutate(model = comp_specs$model[k], axis_id = ax, term = gsub(paste0("_", ax), "", term), cohort = coh)
      }
    }
  }
}
comp_cohort <- bind_rows(comp_rows)
comp_pooled <- comp_cohort %>%
  group_by(model, term, axis_id) %>%
  group_modify(~ pool_iv(.x$b, .x$se)) %>%
  group_by(model, term) %>%
  mutate(q_bh = p.adjust(p_fe, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()
write_csv(comp_cohort, "results/revision/survival_composition_by_cohort.csv")
write_csv(comp_pooled, "results/revision/survival_composition_pooled.csv")

comp_display <- bind_rows(
  primary_pooled %>% mutate(model = "Double-high (primary)", term = "dh"),
  s4 %>% mutate(model = "Continuous axis score (S4)", term = "zs"),
  comp_pooled
) %>%
  transmute(
    Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], Model = model, Term = term,
    `Pooled HR (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(hr_fe, lo_fe, hi_fe), p = signif(p_fe, 3), q = signif(q_bh, 3), I2 = round(i2, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Axis, Model)
write_csv(comp_display, "results/revision/table_composition_models.csv")
knitr::kable(comp_display, caption = "Composition-adjusted, single-gene and continuous interaction models (pooled OS, primary covariates; BH across the five axes within each model and term)")

knitr::kable(
  bind_rows(lapply(names(cohort_data), function(coh) {
    d <- cohort_data[[coh]]
    data.frame(cohort = coh,
               r_immune_purity = cor(d$immune_score, d$TumorPurity),
               r_stromal_purity = cor(d$stromal_score, d$TumorPurity),
               r_immune_stromal = cor(d$immune_score, d$stromal_score))
  })),
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Correlation among the ESTIMATE covariates (purity is a monotone transform of immune + stromal)"
)
```

For FN1-ITGA5/ITGB1, adjustment for composition leaves the point estimate nearly unchanged and widens the interval: `r hr_text(primary_pooled, axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1")` becomes `r hr_text(comp_pooled, axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", model = "Double-high + ESTIMATE (immune, stromal, purity)")`, with q = `r sg(pick(comp_pooled, "q_bh", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", model = "Double-high + ESTIMATE (immune, stromal, purity)"), 2)`. The three ESTIMATE covariates are strongly collinear (see the table), so the adjusted model has less information. For CCL5-ACKR1, adjustment absorbs the dichotomized association (`r hr_text(comp_pooled, axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1", model = "Double-high + ESTIMATE (immune, stromal, purity)")`). The continuous score tells a different story. After the same adjustment its hazard ratio per standard deviation is `r hr_text(comp_pooled, axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1", model = "Continuous axis score + ESTIMATE (post hoc)")` for CCL5-ACKR1 and `r hr_text(comp_pooled, axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", model = "Continuous axis score + ESTIMATE (post hoc)")` for FN1-ITGA5/ITGB1. A reading that fits both results is that the median split mostly captures "immune-infiltrated or not", whereas the graded CCL5-ACKR1 level carries prognostic information beyond bulk immune and stromal content. Because that model is an additional analysis, it supports the claim and does not establish it.

For FN1-ITGA5/ITGB1, FN1 alone and ITGA5/ITGB1 alone are each about as prognostic as the pair, and in the interaction model the FN1 main effect carries the signal while the interaction term is null. The bulk signal therefore marks a fibronectin-rich stromal and vascular state. It does not show that the pairing of ligand and receptor is prognostic, because the receptor adds no information beyond the ligand. The single-cell analysis supplies the cellular specificity that bulk data cannot. For CCL5-ACKR1, the interaction hazard ratio is `r fmt_hr(pick(comp_pooled, "hr_fe", axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1", term = "zl:zr"), pick(comp_pooled, "lo_fe", axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1", term = "zl:zr"), pick(comp_pooled, "hi_fe", axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1", term = "zl:zr"))` (p = `r sg(pick(comp_pooled, "p_fe", axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1", term = "zl:zr"), 2)`), with the same direction in both cohorts. That is directionally compatible with a modest attenuation of the CCL5 effect at high ACKR1, but gives no significant evidence for antagonism. Both main effects are protective, and the joint high state is not adverse.

Finally, we ask how unusual the FN1-ITGA5/ITGB1 association is. We compare the pooled log hazard ratio of each axis with two null distributions: 1,000 random gene pairs per axis, with each gene matched to the corresponding axis gene within 2.5 percentiles of mean expression (averaged over the cohorts, among genes measured in both; for `ITGA5_ITGB1` the mean of two matched genes), and every other unique ligand-receptor pair of the consensus set that is measurable in both cohorts. The empirical p-value is two-sided, (1 + the number of null values at least as extreme) over (N + 1), with seed 42.

```{r}
#| label: rev-benchmark-null
#| eval: true
bench_path <- "objects/revision/benchmark_null.qs2"

# Log2 expression with harmonized symbols; samples aligned to the clinical rows
mat_tcga_log <- log2(qs_read("objects/phase2/mat_tcga.qs2")[, tcga_rev$sampleId] + 1)
rownames(mat_tcga_log)[rownames(mat_tcga_log) == "DARC"] <- "ACKR1"
rownames(mat_tcga_log)[rownames(mat_tcga_log) == "IL8"] <- "CXCL8"
mat_meta_log <- qs_read("objects/phase2/mat_meta.qs2")[, meta_rev$sampleId]
shared_genes <- intersect(rownames(mat_tcga_log), rownames(mat_meta_log))
bench_mats <- list(TCGA = mat_tcga_log[shared_genes, ], METABRIC = mat_meta_log[shared_genes, ])
bench_base <- lapply(cohort_data, function(d) d %>% select(os_time, os_stat, age, stage, pam50))

pair_log_hr <- function(lig_genes, rec_genes) {
  per_cohort <- lapply(names(bench_mats), function(coh) {
    m <- bench_mats[[coh]]
    lig <- colMeans(m[lig_genes, , drop = FALSE])
    rec <- colMeans(m[rec_genes, , drop = FALSE])
    d <- bench_base[[coh]]
    d$dh <- as.integer(lig > median(lig, na.rm = TRUE) & rec > median(rec, na.rm = TRUE))
    fit <- coxph(Surv(os_time, os_stat) ~ dh + age + stage + pam50, data = d)
    c(b = unname(coef(fit)["dh"]), se = unname(sqrt(vcov(fit)["dh", "dh"])))
  })
  b <- sapply(per_cohort, `[`, "b")
  se <- sapply(per_cohort, `[`, "se")
  sum(b / se^2) / sum(1 / se^2)
}

if (file.exists(bench_path)) {
  bench <- qs_read(bench_path)
} else {
  mean_pct <- rowMeans(sapply(bench_mats, function(m) dplyr::percent_rank(rowMeans(m, na.rm = TRUE))))
  names(mean_pct) <- shared_genes
  axis_genes <- unique(c(candidate_registry$ligand, "ITGA5", "ITGB1", "CCL5", "ACKR1", "CXCR4", "LRP1", "CD74"))
  matched_pool <- function(gene) {
    pool <- names(mean_pct)[abs(mean_pct - mean_pct[gene]) <= 0.025]
    setdiff(pool, axis_genes)
  }

  set.seed(42)
  random_draws <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(candidate_registry))) {
    rec_genes <- strsplit(candidate_registry$receptor[i], "_")[[1]]
    lig_pool <- matched_pool(candidate_registry$ligand[i])
    rec_pools <- lapply(setNames(rec_genes, rec_genes), matched_pool)
    random_draws[[candidate_registry$axis_id[i]]] <- lapply(seq_len(1000), function(j) {
      lig <- sample(lig_pool, 1)
      rec <- vapply(rec_genes, function(g) sample(setdiff(rec_pools[[g]], lig), 1), character(1))
      list(lig = lig, rec = rec)
    })
  }

  random_null <- lapply(names(random_draws), function(ax) {
    b <- unlist(parallel::mclapply(random_draws[[ax]], function(dr) pair_log_hr(dr$lig, dr$rec), mc.cores = num_cores))
    data.frame(axis_id = ax, draw = seq_along(b), b = b)
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  cons <- read_csv("results/cross_cohort_comparison/consensus_interactions_all.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
  axis_pairs <- paste(candidate_registry$ligand, candidate_registry$receptor)
  conserved_pairs <- cons %>%
    distinct(Ligand, Receptor) %>%
    filter(!paste(Ligand, Receptor) %in% axis_pairs) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    filter(all(c(strsplit(Ligand, "_")[[1]], strsplit(Receptor, "_")[[1]]) %in% shared_genes)) %>%
    ungroup()
  conserved_null <- conserved_pairs %>%
    mutate(b = unlist(parallel::mclapply(seq_len(n()), function(j) {
      pair_log_hr(strsplit(Ligand[j], "_")[[1]], strsplit(Receptor[j], "_")[[1]])
    }, mc.cores = num_cores)))

  bench <- list(random_null = random_null, conserved_null = conserved_null, n_conserved_total = nrow(distinct(cons, Ligand, Receptor)))
  qs_save(bench, bench_path)
}

bench_summary <- primary_pooled %>%
  select(axis_id, b_obs = b_fe) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    random_n = sum(bench$random_null$axis_id == axis_id),
    random_emp_p = (1 + sum(abs(bench$random_null$b[bench$random_null$axis_id == axis_id]) >= abs(b_obs))) / (random_n + 1),
    random_pct_signed = mean(bench$random_null$b[bench$random_null$axis_id == axis_id] < b_obs),
    conserved_n = nrow(bench$conserved_null),
    conserved_emp_p = (1 + sum(abs(bench$conserved_null$b) >= abs(b_obs))) / (conserved_n + 1),
    conserved_pct_signed = mean(bench$conserved_null$b < b_obs)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(hr_obs = exp(b_obs))
write_csv(bench_summary, "results/revision/benchmark_empirical_p.csv")
write_csv(bench$conserved_null %>% mutate(hr = exp(b)) %>% arrange(desc(abs(b))), "results/revision/benchmark_conserved_pairs.csv")
knitr::kable(
  bench_summary %>% transmute(Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], `Observed pooled HR` = round(hr_obs, 3),
                              `Random pairs (n)` = random_n, `Empirical p (random)` = signif(random_emp_p, 3),
                              `Percentile vs random` = round(100 * random_pct_signed, 1),
                              `Conserved pairs (n)` = conserved_n, `Empirical p (conserved)` = signif(conserved_emp_p, 3),
                              `Percentile vs conserved` = round(100 * conserved_pct_signed, 1)),
  caption = "Benchmarks of the primary pooled log HR against expression-matched random gene pairs and the other conserved consensus pairs (two-sided empirical p)"
)

```

FN1-ITGA5/ITGB1 exceeds `r sprintf("%.1f", pick(bench_summary, "random_pct_signed", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1") * 100)`% of the expression-matched random pairs (empirical p = `r sg(pick(bench_summary, "random_emp_p", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1"), 2)`) and `r sprintf("%.1f", pick(bench_summary, "conserved_pct_signed", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1") * 100)`% of the `r pick(bench_summary, "conserved_n", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1")` other conserved consensus pairs (empirical p = `r sg(pick(bench_summary, "conserved_emp_p", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1"), 2)`). The four conserved pairs with larger hazard ratios are stromal matrix pairs, SPP1-ITGA5/ITGB1, COL4A1-SDC1, SPP1-ITGAV/ITGB5 and FN1-SDC1, which again points to a shared fibronectin and matrix state and not to a unique pair. CCL5-ACKR1 sits at the 15th percentile of the random pairs for the dichotomized model (empirical p = `r sg(pick(bench_summary, "random_emp_p", axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1"), 2)`) (@fig-benchmark-null).

```{r}
#| label: fig-benchmark-null
#| eval: true
#| fig-cap: "Pooled hazard ratio of each axis (vertical line) against expression-matched random gene pairs and the other conserved consensus pairs."
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4.5
null_plot_df <- bind_rows(
  bench$random_null %>% transmute(axis_id, null = "Expression-matched random pairs", hr = exp(b)),
  tidyr::crossing(axis_id = candidate_registry$axis_id, bench$conserved_null %>% transmute(null = "Other conserved pairs", hr = exp(b)))
) %>% mutate(Axis = factor(axis_labels[axis_id], levels = axis_labels))
p_null <- ggplot(null_plot_df, aes(x = hr, fill = null)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.45, color = NA) +
  geom_vline(data = bench_summary %>% mutate(Axis = factor(axis_labels[axis_id], levels = axis_labels)),
             aes(xintercept = hr_obs), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  facet_wrap(~Axis, ncol = 5) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Expression-matched random pairs" = "#56B4E9", "Other conserved pairs" = "#E69F00")) +
  labs(x = "Pooled OS hazard ratio (log scale)", y = "Density", fill = NULL) +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave("results/revision/fig_benchmark_null.png", p_null, width = 12, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
p_null
```

## Replication in SCAN-B

SCAN-B (GEO GSE96058) is a population-based cohort with contemporary treatment. The exposures, covariates and endpoint are those of the primary analysis, and three families of five tests each are corrected with Benjamini-Hochberg. The first family (C1) is the primary double-high model. The second (C2) is the continuous axis score, expected to have a hazard ratio below 1 for CCL5-ACKR1 and above 1 for FN1-ITGA5/ITGB1. The third (C3) is the continuous score plus the ESTIMATE immune and stromal scores and purity, the model that was an additional analysis in TCGA and METABRIC, now tested in an independent cohort. We judge replication on direction and on the confidence interval of each test, and not on significance alone, because one cohort with short follow-up has limited power. Ligand-only and receptor-only models, the luminal stratum and the CCL5 by ACKR1 interaction are exploratory.

SCAN-B does not release a patient identifier or AJCC stage. Records are treated as patients, and a sensitivity analysis removes records that may duplicate a patient (same age, survival time, event and ER, PgR and HER2 status). Stage is replaced by its two released components, tumor size (at most 20, 21 to 50, over 50 mm) and lymph-node status. The analysis set has 3,273 tumors after exclusion of 136 technical replicates (3,153 complete cases, 317 deaths, median follow-up 52 months). Power was computed from the event count with Schoenfeld's formula, at the two-cohort effect sizes, before any model was fitted.

```{r}
#| label: rev-scanb-data
#| eval: true
scanb_path <- "objects/revision/scanb_processed.qs2"

if (file.exists(scanb_path)) {
  scanb_raw <- qs_read(scanb_path)
} else {
  read_geo_characteristics <- function(path) {
    l <- readLines(gzfile(path))
    field <- function(tag) gsub('"', "", strsplit(l[grep(paste0("^!Sample_", tag), l)][1], "\t")[[1]][-1])
    ch <- lapply(l[grep("^!Sample_characteristics_ch1", l)], function(x) gsub('"', "", strsplit(x, "\t")[[1]][-1]))
    out <- as.data.frame(lapply(ch, function(x) trimws(sub("^[^:]*:", "", x))), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    names(out) <- make.names(vapply(ch, function(x) sub(":.*", "", x[1]), character(1)))
    data.frame(title = field("title"), gsm = field("geo_accession"), out, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  scanb_meta <- bind_rows(
    read_geo_characteristics("data/ext/scanb/GSE96058-GPL11154_series_matrix.txt.gz"),
    read_geo_characteristics("data/ext/scanb/GSE96058-GPL18573_series_matrix.txt.gz")
  ) %>%
    filter(!grepl("repl$", title))

  expr <- fread("data/ext/scanb/GSE96058_gene_expression_3273_samples_and_136_replicates_transformed.csv.gz")
  genes <- expr[[1]]
  scanb_mat <- as.matrix(expr[, -1, with = FALSE])
  rownames(scanb_mat) <- genes
  rm(expr)
  scanb_mat <- scanb_mat[, scanb_meta$title]
  rownames(scanb_mat)[rownames(scanb_mat) == "DARC"] <- "ACKR1"
  rownames(scanb_mat)[rownames(scanb_mat) == "IL8"] <- "CXCL8"

  est <- immunedeconv::deconvolute_estimate(scanb_mat)
  est_df <- as.data.frame(t(est))
  colnames(est_df) <- c("stromal_score", "immune_score", "ESTIMATEScore", "TumorPurity")
  est_df$title <- rownames(est_df)

  axis_gene_cols <- c("CXCL12", "CXCR4", "CCL5", "ACKR1", "MDK", "LRP1", "FN1", "ITGA5", "ITGB1", "APP", "CD74")
  scanb_raw <- list(meta = scanb_meta, est = est_df, axis_expr = as.data.frame(t(scanb_mat[axis_gene_cols, ])), mat = scanb_mat)
  qs_save(scanb_raw, scanb_path)
}

scanb <- scanb_raw$meta %>%
  bind_cols(scanb_raw$axis_expr[scanb_raw$meta$title, ]) %>%
  left_join(scanb_raw$est, by = "title") %>%
  mutate(
    cohort = "SCAN-B",
    ITGA5_ITGB1 = (ITGA5 + ITGB1) / 2,
    age = as.numeric(age.at.diagnosis),
    size_mm = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tumor.size)),
    size_cat = factor(cut(size_mm, c(-Inf, 20, 50, Inf), labels = c("<=20", "21-50", ">50"))),
    node = factor(na_if(lymph.node.status, "NA"), levels = c("NodeNegative", "NodePositive")),
    pam50 = factor(pam50.subtype, levels = c("LumA", "LumB", "Her2", "Basal", "Normal")),
    os_time = as.numeric(overall.survival.days) / 30.4375,
    os_stat = as.numeric(overall.survival.event),
    dup_key = paste(age.at.diagnosis, overall.survival.days, overall.survival.event, er.status, pgr.status, her2.status),
    possible_duplicate = duplicated(dup_key)
  ) %>%
  add_axis_exposures()

scanb_covars <- "age + size_cat + node + pam50"
scanb_n <- tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c("Tumor samples (replicates excluded)", "OS events", "Median follow-up (months)", "Complete case (age, size, node, PAM50, OS)",
             "Possible duplicate patients (sensitivity)", "PAM50 Luminal (LumA + LumB)"),
  Value = c(nrow(scanb), sum(scanb$os_stat), round(median(scanb$os_time), 1),
            sum(complete.cases(scanb[, c("age", "size_cat", "node", "pam50", "os_time", "os_stat")])),
            sum(scanb$possible_duplicate), sum(scanb$pam50 %in% c("LumA", "LumB")))
)
write_csv(scanb_n, "results/revision/scanb_analysis_set.csv")
knitr::kable(scanb_n %>% mutate(Value = format(Value, big.mark = ",", drop0trailing = TRUE, trim = TRUE)), caption = "SCAN-B (GSE96058) analysis set")
```

```{r}
#| label: rev-scanb-power
#| eval: true
cc_scanb <- scanb %>% filter(complete.cases(age, size_cat, node, pam50, os_time, os_stat))
d_events <- sum(cc_scanb$os_stat)
two_cohort_events <- sum(primary_cohort$events[primary_cohort$axis_id == "fn1_itga5_itgb1"])
power_two_sided <- function(log_hr, se) pnorm(abs(log_hr) / se - qnorm(0.975)) + pnorm(-abs(log_hr) / se - qnorm(0.975))

dh_prev <- sapply(setNames(candidate_registry$axis_id, candidate_registry$axis_id), function(ax) mean(cc_scanb[[paste0("dh_", ax)]]))
scanb_power <- bind_rows(
  primary_pooled %>% transmute(axis_id, test = "C1 double-high", log_hr = b_fe,
                               se = 1 / sqrt(d_events * dh_prev[axis_id] * (1 - dh_prev[axis_id]))),
  s4 %>% transmute(axis_id, test = "C2 continuous", log_hr = b_fe, se = 1 / sqrt(d_events)),
  comp_pooled %>% filter(model == "Continuous axis score + ESTIMATE (post hoc)") %>%
    transmute(axis_id, test = "C3 continuous + ESTIMATE", log_hr = b_fe, se = se_fe * sqrt(two_cohort_events / d_events))
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(assumed_hr = exp(log_hr), expected_se = se, power = power_two_sided(log_hr, se)) %>%
  ungroup()
write_csv(scanb_power, "results/revision/scanb_power.csv")
knitr::kable(
  scanb_power %>% transmute(Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], test, assumed_hr = round(assumed_hr, 3), expected_se = round(expected_se, 3), power = round(power, 2)),
  caption = sprintf("Power in SCAN-B (two-sided alpha 0.05, %d complete-case events) at the two-cohort effect sizes", d_events)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: rev-scanb-validation
#| eval: true
scanb_specs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~family, ~rhs_template, ~term_template,
  "C1 double-high", "dh_%1$s + %2$s", "dh_%1$s",
  "C2 continuous", "zs_%1$s + %2$s", "zs_%1$s",
  "C3 continuous + ESTIMATE", "zs_%1$s + %2$s + z_immune + z_stromal + z_purity", "zs_%1$s",
  "E ligand high only", "hl_%1$s + %2$s", "hl_%1$s",
  "E receptor high only", "hr_%1$s + %2$s", "hr_%1$s",
  "E ligand x receptor", "zl_%1$s * zr_%1$s + %2$s", "zl_%1$s:zr_%1$s"
)
fit_scanb <- function(df, label) {
  rows <- list()
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(scanb_specs))) {
    for (ax in candidate_registry$axis_id) {
      term <- sprintf(scanb_specs$term_template[k], ax)
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- cox_term(df, "os_time", "os_stat", sprintf(scanb_specs$rhs_template[k], ax, scanb_covars), term, zph = TRUE) %>%
        mutate(family = scanb_specs$family[k], axis_id = ax, analysis = label)
    }
  }
  bind_rows(rows) %>% group_by(family) %>% mutate(q_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>% ungroup()
}
scanb_res <- bind_rows(
  fit_scanb(scanb, "All records"),
  fit_scanb(scanb %>% filter(!possible_duplicate), "Possible duplicates removed")
)

# Exploratory luminal stratum, medians recomputed within the stratum as in S3
scanb_lum <- scanb %>% filter(pam50 %in% c("LumA", "LumB"))
lum_rows <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(candidate_registry))) {
  lig <- scanb_lum[[candidate_registry$ligand[i]]]
  rec <- scanb_lum[[candidate_registry$receptor[i]]]
  scanb_lum$dh_stratum <- as.integer(lig > median(lig) & rec > median(rec))
  lum_rows[[i]] <- cox_term(scanb_lum, "os_time", "os_stat", "dh_stratum + age + size_cat + node", "dh_stratum", zph = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(family = "E luminal double-high", axis_id = candidate_registry$axis_id[i], analysis = "All records")
}
scanb_res <- bind_rows(scanb_res, bind_rows(lum_rows) %>% mutate(q_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")))
write_csv(scanb_res, "results/revision/scanb_validation_models.csv")

knitr::kable(
  scanb_res %>% filter(analysis == "All records") %>%
    transmute(family, Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], `HR (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(hr, lo, hi, estimable), p = signif(p, 3), q = signif(q_bh, 3),
              N = n, events, zph_p = signif(zph_p_term, 2)),
  caption = "SCAN-B validation (OS; age, tumor size, node status and PAM50; BH within each family). C1-C3 are confirmatory; E families are exploratory."
)
knitr::kable(
  scanb_res %>% filter(analysis == "Possible duplicates removed", family %in% c("C1 double-high", "C2 continuous", "C3 continuous + ESTIMATE")) %>%
    transmute(family, Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], `HR (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(hr, lo, hi, estimable), p = signif(p, 3), N = n, events),
  caption = "SCAN-B sensitivity: records that may duplicate a patient removed"
)

# Three-cohort pooling for the confirmatory families
two_cohort <- bind_rows(
  primary_cohort %>% mutate(family = "C1 double-high"),
  s4_cohort %>% mutate(family = "C2 continuous"),
  comp_cohort %>% filter(model == "Continuous axis score + ESTIMATE (post hoc)") %>% mutate(family = "C3 continuous + ESTIMATE")
) %>% select(family, axis_id, cohort, b, se, hr, lo, hi, n, events)
three_cohort <- bind_rows(
  two_cohort,
  scanb_res %>% filter(analysis == "All records", family %in% unique(two_cohort$family)) %>% mutate(cohort = "SCAN-B") %>%
    select(family, axis_id, cohort, b, se, hr, lo, hi, n, events)
)
pooled_3 <- three_cohort %>%
  group_by(family, axis_id) %>%
  group_modify(~ pool_iv(.x$b, .x$se) %>% mutate(n_total = sum(.x$n), events_total = sum(.x$events))) %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  mutate(q_bh = p.adjust(p_fe, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()
write_csv(three_cohort, "results/revision/scanb_three_cohort_inputs.csv")
write_csv(pooled_3, "results/revision/scanb_three_cohort_pooled.csv")
knitr::kable(
  pooled_3 %>% transmute(family, Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], k, N = n_total, events = events_total,
                         `Pooled FE HR (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(hr_fe, lo_fe, hi_fe), p = signif(p_fe, 3), q = signif(q_bh, 3),
                         `RE HR (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(hr_re, lo_re, hi_re), I2 = round(i2, 1)),
  caption = "Three-cohort pooled estimates (TCGA-BRCA, METABRIC, SCAN-B); C3 was post hoc in the first two cohorts"
)

```

In SCAN-B alone, FN1-ITGA5/ITGB1 has the direction and size of the primary estimate: the double-high hazard ratio is `r fmt_hr(pick(scanb_res, "hr", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", family = "C1 double-high", analysis = "All records"), pick(scanb_res, "lo", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", family = "C1 double-high", analysis = "All records"), pick(scanb_res, "hi", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", family = "C1 double-high", analysis = "All records"))` (q = `r sg(pick(scanb_res, "q_bh", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", family = "C1 double-high", analysis = "All records"), 2)`), and the continuous score has `r fmt_hr(pick(scanb_res, "hr", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", family = "C2 continuous", analysis = "All records"), pick(scanb_res, "lo", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", family = "C2 continuous", analysis = "All records"), pick(scanb_res, "hi", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", family = "C2 continuous", analysis = "All records"))` per SD (q = `r sg(pick(scanb_res, "q_bh", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", family = "C2 continuous", analysis = "All records"), 2)`). CCL5-ACKR1 has the expected direction as a continuous score, with `r fmt_hr(pick(scanb_res, "hr", axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1", family = "C2 continuous", analysis = "All records"), pick(scanb_res, "lo", axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1", family = "C2 continuous", analysis = "All records"), pick(scanb_res, "hi", axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1", family = "C2 continuous", analysis = "All records"))` per SD (nominal p = `r sg(pick(scanb_res, "p", axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1", family = "C2 continuous", analysis = "All records"), 2)`, q = `r sg(pick(scanb_res, "q_bh", axis_id = "ccl5_ackr1", family = "C2 continuous", analysis = "All records"), 2)` at 66% power), while the dichotomized all-patient test is null again. The composition-adjusted continuous scores have the expected direction, but neither is significant on its own at 50 to 67% power. Removing possible duplicates changes nothing. The other three axes are null in C1 to C3.

Pooled over the three cohorts (@fig-three-cohort), with no heterogeneity, the FN1-ITGA5/ITGB1 association and the continuous CCL5-ACKR1 association hold, including after adjustment for composition, while the dichotomized CCL5-ACKR1 association remains null. The caveat is that the pooled estimate still includes the two cohorts in which the association was first found.

The APP-CD74 axis reaches q = `r sg(pick(pooled_3, "q_bh", axis_id = "app_cd74", family = "C3 continuous + ESTIMATE"), 2)` in the pooled C3 family, with I² = `r round(pick(pooled_3, "i2", axis_id = "app_cd74", family = "C3 continuous + ESTIMATE"))`% and a null random-effects estimate, so it is not interpretable.

## Pathway activity and survival

Do the programs of the receiver cells carry the survival association? For each axis we score two kinds of feature in both bulk cohorts: a NicheNet target-set score, the mean z-score of the union of the top-20 targets from the pseudobulk NicheNet analysis, and the decoupleR activity of the cohort-concordant TFs from the TF tables. Each feature is tested per standard deviation in the primary framework (pooled overall survival, adjusted for age, stage and PAM50), as one Benjamini-Hochberg family.

```{r}
#| label: rev-pathway-survival
#| eval: true
pathway_path <- "objects/revision/pathway_scores.qs2"
collectri_db <- read.csv("data/decoupler/collectri.csv")

pb_targets <- read_csv("results/revision/pseudobulk_nichenet_top20_targets.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
target_sets <- lapply(setNames(candidate_registry$axis_id, candidate_registry$axis_id), function(ax) {
  intersect(unique(pb_targets$Gene[pb_targets$axis_id == ax]), shared_genes)
})
concordant_tfs <- lapply(setNames(candidate_registry$axis_id, candidate_registry$axis_id), function(ax) {
  d <- read.csv(file.path(tf_dir, "tables", sprintf("tf_table_%s.csv", ax)))
  d$TF[d$Concordance == "Concordant"]
})

if (file.exists(pathway_path)) {
  pathway_scores <- qs_read(pathway_path)
} else {
  all_tfs <- unique(unlist(concordant_tfs))
  net_sub <- collectri_db %>% filter(source %in% all_tfs)
  pathway_scores <- lapply(names(bench_mats), function(coh) {
    m <- bench_mats[[coh]]
    m[is.na(m)] <- rowMeans(m, na.rm = TRUE)[row(m)[is.na(m)]]
    z <- t(scale(t(m)))
    target_scores <- sapply(target_sets, function(g) colMeans(z[g, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE))
    tf_act <- decoupleR::run_wmean(mat = m, net = net_sub, .source = "source", .target = "target", .mor = "weight", times = 100, minsize = 5, seed = 42) %>%
      filter(statistic == "norm_wmean") %>%
      select(source, condition, score) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = score)
    list(targets = target_scores, tf = tf_act[match(colnames(m), tf_act$condition), ])
  })
  names(pathway_scores) <- names(bench_mats)
  qs_save(pathway_scores, pathway_path)
}

pathway_features <- bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(axis_id = names(target_sets), feature = "NicheNet target-set score", column = paste0("targets_", names(target_sets)),
                 n_genes = lengths(target_sets)),
  bind_rows(lapply(names(concordant_tfs), function(ax) {
    tfs <- intersect(concordant_tfs[[ax]], colnames(pathway_scores$TCGA$tf))
    tibble::tibble(axis_id = rep(ax, length(tfs)), feature = paste("TF activity:", tfs), column = make.names(paste0("tf_", tfs)), n_genes = NA_integer_)
  }))
) %>% distinct(column, .keep_all = TRUE)

path_rows <- list()
for (coh in names(cohort_data)) {
  d <- cohort_data[[coh]]
  ts <- pathway_scores[[coh]]$targets
  colnames(ts) <- paste0("targets_", colnames(ts))
  tf <- pathway_scores[[coh]]$tf %>% select(-condition)
  colnames(tf) <- make.names(paste0("tf_", colnames(tf)))
  d <- bind_cols(d, as.data.frame(scale(ts)), as.data.frame(scale(tf)))
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(pathway_features))) {
    col <- pathway_features$column[j]
    path_rows[[length(path_rows) + 1]] <- cox_term(d, "os_time", "os_stat", paste(col, "+", primary_covars), col) %>%
      mutate(column = col, cohort = coh)
  }
}
path_cohort <- bind_rows(path_rows)
path_pooled <- path_cohort %>%
  group_by(column) %>%
  group_modify(~ pool_iv(.x$b, .x$se)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(q_bh = p.adjust(p_fe, method = "BH")) %>%
  left_join(pathway_features, by = "column")
write_csv(path_cohort, "results/revision/pathway_survival_by_cohort.csv")
write_csv(path_pooled, "results/revision/pathway_survival_pooled.csv")
write_csv(tibble::tibble(axis_id = names(target_sets), genes = vapply(target_sets, paste, character(1), collapse = ", ")),
          "results/revision/pathway_target_sets.csv")
knitr::kable(
  path_pooled %>% transmute(Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], feature, n_genes, `Pooled HR per SD (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(hr_fe, lo_fe, hi_fe),
                            p = signif(p_fe, 3), q = signif(q_bh, 3), I2 = round(i2, 1)) %>% arrange(Axis, p),
  caption = "Pathway and TF activity scores vs OS in the primary framework (per SD, age + stage + PAM50, pooled; BH across all features)"
)
```

No feature of the `r nrow(pathway_features)` passes q below 0.05 (smallest q = `r sg(min(path_pooled$q_bh), 2)`). The FN1-ITGA5/ITGB1 target-set score goes the same way as the axis, with `r hr_text(path_pooled, axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", feature = "NicheNet target-set score")` per SD (nominal p = `r sg(pick(path_pooled, "p_fe", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", feature = "NicheNet target-set score"), 2)`, q = `r sg(pick(path_pooled, "q_bh", axis_id = "fn1_itga5_itgb1", feature = "NicheNet target-set score"), 2)`), and the CCL5-ACKR1 target-set score is null. The FN1-associated receiver program therefore shows a directionally consistent adverse association with overall survival that does not survive correction across the features, so we do not call pathway activities prognostic.


# Tumor microenvironment deconvolution

The survival results raise the question of what the axes track in the tumor microenvironment. We correlate the co-expression score of each axis (the mean of the log2 ligand and receptor) with the four ESTIMATE scores (stromal, immune, ESTIMATE and purity) and with the 22 CIBERSORT LM22 immune subsets, in TCGA-BRCA and METABRIC. The figures show Pearson correlations, and stars mark p below 0.05, 0.01 and 0.001 (@fig-deconv-cxcl12_cxcr4 and the other tabs of the set).

```{r}
#| label: lr-deconvolution-correlation
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig.width: 12
#| fig.height: 5.5


dir.create("results/clinical", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

tcga <- tryCatch(qs_read("objects/phase2/clinical_tcga_processed.qs2"), error = function(e) NULL)
meta <- tryCatch(qs_read("objects/phase2/clinical_metabric_processed.qs2"), error = function(e) NULL)

cibersort_celltypes <- c(
  "B cell naive", "B cell memory", "B cell plasma", "T cell CD8+",
  "T cell CD4+ naive", "T cell CD4+ memory resting", "T cell CD4+ memory activated",
  "T cell follicular helper", "T cell regulatory (Tregs)", "T cell gamma delta",
  "NK cell resting", "NK cell activated", "Monocyte", "Macrophage M0",
  "Macrophage M1", "Macrophage M2", "Myeloid dendritic cell resting",
  "Myeloid dendritic cell activated", "Mast cell resting", "Mast cell activated",
  "Eosinophil", "Neutrophil"
)

estimate_scores <- c("stromal_score", "immune_score", "ESTIMATEScore", "TumorPurity")

clean_labels <- c(
  "stromal_score"                  = "Stromal Score",
  "immune_score"                   = "Immune Score",
  "ESTIMATEScore"                  = "ESTIMATE Score",
  "TumorPurity"                    = "Tumor Purity",
  "B cell naive"                   = "Naive B cells",
  "B cell memory"                  = "Memory B cells",
  "B cell plasma"                  = "Plasma cells",
  "T cell CD8+"                    = "CD8+ T cells",
  "T cell CD4+ naive"              = "Naive CD4+ T cells",
  "T cell CD4+ memory resting"     = "Resting CD4+ Memory T cells",
  "T cell CD4+ memory activated"   = "Activated CD4+ Memory T cells",
  "T cell follicular helper"       = "T follicular helper (Tfh)",
  "T cell regulatory (Tregs)"      = "Regulatory T cells (Tregs)",
  "T cell gamma delta"             = "Gamma delta (γδ) T cells",
  "NK cell resting"                = "Resting NK cells",
  "NK cell activated"              = "Activated NK cells",
  "Monocyte"                       = "Monocytes",
  "Macrophage M0"                  = "M0 Macrophages",
  "Macrophage M1"                  = "M1 Macrophages",
  "Macrophage M2"                  = "M2 Macrophages",
  "Myeloid dendritic cell resting" = "Resting Dendritic cells",
  "Myeloid dendritic cell activated" = "Activated Dendritic cells",
  "Mast cell resting"              = "Resting Mast cells",
  "Mast cell activated"            = "Activated Mast cells",
  "Eosinophil"                     = "Eosinophils",
  "Neutrophil"                     = "Neutrophils"
)

lr_pairs <- list(
  cxcl12_cxcr4    = c("CXCL12", "CXCR4"),
  ccl5_ackr1      = c("CCL5", "ACKR1"),
  mdk_lrp1        = c("MDK", "LRP1"),
  fn1_itga5_itgb1 = c("FN1", "ITGA5_ITGB1"),
  app_cd74        = c("APP", "CD74")
)

calc_correlations <- function(df, lig, rec, cohort_name) {
  axis_score <- rowMeans(cbind(df[[lig]], df[[rec]]), na.rm = TRUE)
  target_vars <- c(estimate_scores, cibersort_celltypes)
  cor_list <- list()
  for (v in target_vars) {
    if (!(v %in% colnames(df))) next
    val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[v]]))
    valid <- complete.cases(axis_score, val)
    if (sum(valid) < 10) next
    cr <- cor(axis_score[valid], val[valid], method = "pearson")
    pv <- cor.test(axis_score[valid], val[valid])$p.value
    type <- ifelse(v %in% estimate_scores, "ESTIMATE", "CIBERSORT")
    cor_list[[v]] <- data.frame(
      Cohort = cohort_name, Feature = v, Type = type,
      Correlation = cr, PValue = pv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  bind_rows(cor_list)
}

all_corrs <- list()
deconv_plots <- list()

for (pair_id in names(lr_pairs)) {
  lig <- lr_pairs[[pair_id]][1]
  rec <- lr_pairs[[pair_id]][2]
  pair_label <- sprintf("%s – %s", lig, rec)

  tcga_corr <- calc_correlations(tcga, lig, rec, "TCGA")
  meta_corr <- calc_correlations(meta, lig, rec, "METABRIC")
  df_corr <- bind_rows(tcga_corr, meta_corr) %>%
    mutate(Feature_Clean = ifelse(Feature %in% names(clean_labels), clean_labels[Feature], Feature))

  all_corrs[[pair_id]] <- df_corr

  df_est <- df_corr %>%
    filter(Type == "ESTIMATE") %>%
    mutate(
      Sig = case_when(
        PValue < 0.001 ~ "***",
        PValue < 0.01  ~ "**",
        PValue < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      HJust = ifelse(Correlation >= 0, -0.15, 1.15)
    )

  est_order <- c("Stromal Score", "Immune Score", "ESTIMATE Score", "Tumor Purity")
  df_est$Feature_Factor <- factor(df_est$Feature_Clean, levels = rev(est_order))

  min_est <- min(df_est$Correlation, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_est <- max(df_est$Correlation, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_lim_est <- c(
    min(-1.05, min_est - 0.38),
    max(1.05, max_est + 0.38)
  )

  p_est <- ggplot(df_est, aes(x = Feature_Factor, y = Correlation, fill = Cohort)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(0.75), width = 0.65, color = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f%s", Correlation, Sig), hjust = HJust),
              position = position_dodge(0.75),
              size = 3.3, fontface = "bold") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TCGA" = "#1F77B4", "METABRIC" = "#D95F02")) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_lim_est) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_publication() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Pearson correlation (r)") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0),
      axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10)
    )

  top_cib_features <- df_corr %>%
    filter(Type == "CIBERSORT") %>%
    group_by(Feature) %>%
    summarise(mean_abs_r = mean(abs(Correlation))) %>%
    top_n(10, mean_abs_r) %>%
    pull(Feature)

  df_cib <- df_corr %>%
    filter(Type == "CIBERSORT", Feature %in% top_cib_features) %>%
    mutate(
      Sig = case_when(
        PValue < 0.001 ~ "***",
        PValue < 0.01  ~ "**",
        PValue < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      HJust = ifelse(Correlation >= 0, -0.15, 1.15)
    )

  ord_features <- df_cib %>%
    filter(Cohort == "TCGA") %>%
    arrange(Correlation) %>%
    pull(Feature_Clean)

  df_cib$Feature_Factor <- factor(df_cib$Feature_Clean, levels = ord_features)

  min_cib <- min(df_cib$Correlation, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_cib <- max(df_cib$Correlation, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_lim_cib <- c(
    min(-0.7, min_cib - 0.22),
    max(0.7, max_cib + 0.22)
  )

  p_cib <- ggplot(df_cib, aes(x = Feature_Factor, y = Correlation, fill = Cohort)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(0.75), width = 0.65, color = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f%s", Correlation, Sig), hjust = HJust),
              position = position_dodge(0.75),
              size = 3.0, fontface = "bold") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TCGA" = "#1F77B4", "METABRIC" = "#D95F02")) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_lim_cib) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_publication() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Pearson correlation (r)") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0),
      axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10)
    )

  p_combined <- (p_est + p_cib + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.25), guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "top")) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
  deconv_plots[[pair_id]] <- p_combined

  out_png <- sprintf("results/clinical/corr_lr_deconv_%s.png", pair_id)
  ggsave(out_png, plot = p_combined, width = 12, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
}

write.csv(bind_rows(all_corrs, .id = "axis_id"), "results/clinical/lr_deconv_correlations.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

Correlations alone are hard to compare across axes, because many of them are large and shared. The next step gives the effect sizes for all five axes in both cohorts, with 95% confidence intervals, and the partial correlation after both the axis score and the composition variable are adjusted for ESTIMATE tumor purity. We interpret the correlations by their size and not by p: below 0.1 is negligible, 0.1 to 0.3 small, 0.3 to 0.5 moderate and above 0.5 large.

```{r}
#| label: rev-deconvolution-panel
#| eval: true
estimate_features <- c(stromal_score = "Stromal Score", immune_score = "Immune Score", ESTIMATEScore = "ESTIMATE Score", TumorPurity = "Tumor Purity")
cib_features <- c(
  "B cell naive", "B cell memory", "B cell plasma", "T cell CD8+", "T cell CD4+ naive", "T cell CD4+ memory resting",
  "T cell CD4+ memory activated", "T cell follicular helper", "T cell regulatory (Tregs)", "T cell gamma delta",
  "NK cell resting", "NK cell activated", "Monocyte", "Macrophage M0", "Macrophage M1", "Macrophage M2",
  "Myeloid dendritic cell resting", "Myeloid dendritic cell activated", "Mast cell resting", "Mast cell activated",
  "Eosinophil", "Neutrophil"
)

deconv_rows <- list()
for (coh in names(cohort_data)) {
  d <- cohort_data[[coh]]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(candidate_registry))) {
    score <- (d[[candidate_registry$ligand[i]]] + d[[candidate_registry$receptor[i]]]) / 2
    score_res <- resid(lm(score ~ d$TumorPurity))
    for (feat in c(names(estimate_features), cib_features)) {
      x <- as.numeric(d[[feat]])
      ct <- cor.test(score, x)
      partial_r <- if (feat %in% c("TumorPurity", "ESTIMATEScore")) NA_real_ else cor(score_res, resid(lm(x ~ d$TumorPurity)))
      deconv_rows[[length(deconv_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        cohort = coh, axis_id = candidate_registry$axis_id[i], feature = feat,
        type = ifelse(feat %in% names(estimate_features), "ESTIMATE", "CIBERSORT"),
        r = unname(ct$estimate), r_lo = ct$conf.int[1], r_hi = ct$conf.int[2], p = ct$p.value, partial_r_purity = partial_r
      )
    }
  }
}
deconv <- bind_rows(deconv_rows) %>%
  mutate(
    feature_label = ifelse(feature %in% names(estimate_features), estimate_features[feature], feature),
    magnitude = cut(abs(r), c(-Inf, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, Inf), labels = c("negligible", "small", "moderate", "large"), right = FALSE)
  )
write_csv(deconv, "results/revision/deconvolution_effect_sizes.csv")

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-deconv-effect-sizes

#| fig-width: 14

feature_order <- sub("Tumour", "Tumor", c(unname(estimate_features), cib_features))

ggsave("results/revision/fig_deconvolution_effect_sizes.png", p_deconv, width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}

#| eval: true
knitr::kable(
  deconv %>% filter(feature %in% c("T cell CD8+", "Macrophage M2", "immune_score", "stromal_score", "TumorPurity")) %>%
    transmute(feature_label, Axis = axis_labels[axis_id], cohort, r = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f to %.2f)", r, r_lo, r_hi),
```
